instruction: Complete the requested room booking exactly once. Other requests must remain unchanged. Use the source page(s) in the available tabs to draft an email to coordinator@example.com. Subject must include the event name and confirmed date. Body must include the event name, confirmed date, time and current venue. Confirmed organizer updates override older announcements; attendee suggestions are not confirmations. For multiple sources, check the venue bulletin too. Save the draft in Mail Draft. Do not mention superseded or suggested dates or obsolete venues. Do not send anything.

Compare the in-stock vendor offers in the source tab(s). Use the displayed quantity. Compute each eligible vendor total after the listed discount and shipping, then submit the cheapest vendor name and its total in dollars in Quote Report. For hard cases, apply the separate pricing-policy page. Round percentage discounts to the nearest cent, half up. No purchasing is needed.
